purpose: Annotation smoke quality review, not model selection or official GT validation
context_required_for_review: Grades 2/3 only; missing means missing, never current-frame-sufficient
near_degenerate_reason: Less than two preview pixels cannot retain a visible subject, interaction, or information; this is an error flag, not a competition crop-size rule
crop_policy: One coherent window on grade 2/3; no box is allowed when no stable window exists and composition confidence records this
density_policy: Report grade counts without imposing a target positive fraction
draft_policy: Never merge drafts into completed labels; report conflicts separately
mutation_policy: Read-only export and analysis; never rewrite labels or import new tasks
independent_unit: Original source video; 60 adjacent frames from two sources are not 60 independent quality observations
